name: AB-UPT + BQA + AGS (DCTS)
description: AB-UPT backbone with BQA and AGS, the lowest DCTS error; one whole-room forward pass with every cell as anchor (slower, more memory).
description_zh: AB-UPT 主干 + BQA + AGS，DCTS 上误差最低；整室一次前向、全部单元作锚点（更慢、显存更大）。
dataset: DCTS (500 parametric GTC rooms; 400 train / 50 val / 50 test)
metric: mean over the five fields of the per-field relative L2 error

memory.note: peak = node_bytes x nodes + row_bytes x rows (rows: nodes for the whole room, tta_rows0 + tta_rows_per_node x nodes for TTA); fit on an RTX 4090, docs/benchmarks/scano-tta-2026-10-29

inference.note: TTA x1 matches the whole-room forward on the four DCTS example rooms (mean error 0.3721 vs 0.3718) in 15-19 s instead of 215-303 s on an RTX 4090; docs/benchmarks/scano-tta-2026-10-29
